subject: POC Kickoff & Next Steps — ClearView / Redwood
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Miller <dmiller@clearview.ai>, Claire Johnson <cjohnson@clearview.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T14:05:00-04:00
Subject: POC Kickoff & Next Steps — ClearView / Redwood

Hi David & Claire,

Great to meet earlier — appreciated the candid conversation about latency constraints and data residency. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- What we agreed: 2-week POC to validate query latency <120ms on typical payloads, and quality on the 50k query sample you provided.
- Action items for ClearView: upload the anonymized sample dataset to the shared Drive folder (see link below), confirm SSO/SAML point of contact, and provision a test service account for API keys.
- Action items for Redwood: provision a Dedicated trial tenant, pre-configure the model variant we discussed (redwood-xl-quant), and schedule a 30m technical session for SE-led onboarding.

Attachments: POC-plan.pdf (outline + success criteria), sample-data-template.csv

Proposed times for the onboarding session: Jul 6 10:00-10:30am ET or Jul 9 11:00-11:30am ET. Let me know what works.

Link to shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPOCshare

If the priority shifts, please tell us — we can pause provisioning to avoid incurring pre-provision costs. Otherwise we’ll start setup once you confirm the upload and SSO contact.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192
From: David Miller <dmiller@clearview.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Johnson <cjohnson@clearview.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff & Next Steps — ClearView / Redwood

Vanessa,

Thanks for the recap — helpful. We're running into a small procurement SSO ticket; infra says they can do the upload but not until EOW (Jul 8). Can we move the onboarding to Jul 9 11:00am ET? That should give them time.

One quick Q: do you support Okta SAML attributes mapping to email + dept? Our security lead will ask.

I'll confirm by EOD if the sample dataset is uploaded.

Best,
David

ClearView Analytics

Subject: Re: POC Kickoff & Next Steps — Quick check-in

Hi David,

Quick check — our provisioning is ready but our telemetry shows zero API calls against your trial tenant and I don't see the sample data in the shared Drive folder. I wanted to confirm whether Jul 9 11:00 still works or if priority has shifted.

If helpful we can do a 20-minute screenshare where our SE (Rishi) will walk through the sample upload and run a quick smoke test — that usually removes the "first-step" friction. Proposed slots today: 11:00am ET or 3:00pm ET. If neither work, share a time that does.

Attachments: quick-setup-guide.md

Related links: HubSpot deal CLRV-2026-07-01 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CLRV-2026-07-01)

Thanks,
Vanessa

Date: 2026-07-12T09:20:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: POC Kickoff & Next Steps — ClearView (no reply)

Forwarding our last note — no reply from ClearView since the July 9 check-in. Suggested next steps:

- Offer white-glove onboarding: 2 hours free SE time to perform the upload and initial validation.
- Offer a limited ramp credit (30% off first month of Dedicated) to re-prioritize.
- If no response by Jul 16, I'll escalate to AE manager for approval to close the trial window.

Can you confirm you're OK offering the SE hours and the ramp credit? Rishi, please draft a short calendar invite template for the screenshare and have the SE ready.

--Priyom
